clauses.quote: The school district is not authorized to disclose to a victim private personnel data regarding an alleged perpetrator who is an employee of the school district.
Any employee violating this policy will be subject to disciplinary action up to and including t;ermination of employment.

Nothing in this policy should be construed as precluding the School Board from adopting additional or alternative programs, procedures, and penalties, in accordance with federal and state laws, in order to achieve the goal of a drug - and alcohol - free public school system.
